task: Build and execute a bounded TeamAI RSI cycle, then preserve evolution and final artifacts on GitHub
target: Reviewer instructions; common protocol/model/taskpack/evaluator/budget stay fixed
baseline_adaptation: Existing reviewer instructions with the same three-value decision contract used for all candidates; no baseline-only handicap
model: Host inherited model and reasoning settings; no per-step overrides
semantics: Independent child judge per evaluation; model-judged results are not human ground truth
acceptance: Per protocol: at least one more complete case with no regressions; or all cases complete in both and >=15% fewer trimmed Unicode codepoints
holdout: One final paired evaluation stage after final candidate selection; no tuning afterward
cost: Record wall time and attempts; token and billing data unavailable unless tool reports them
github: Required deliverable, all rounds and final assets; destination being resolved via authenticated connector
